_comment: Copy this to 'openocd-mcp.json' in your project root and edit. The server auto-loads it. interface_cfg/target_cfg are relative to OpenOCD's scripts dir. svd_file/elf_file may be absolute, or relative to the MCP project dir (e.g. a file under ./svd). elf_file is usually an absolute path into your firmware's build output.
_transport_comment: Set to 'swd' for a J-Link on Cortex-M (with interface_cfg 'interface/jlink.cfg'); leave empty for ST-Link.
_permissions_comment: Optional safety gates. Omit the whole block to use defaults (writes + flash allowed, flash-erase OFF). read_only=true blocks every mutating op.
